versions.changelog:
Initial release of Desktop Notify: a cross-platform desktop notification assistant.

- Supports system notifications and sound alerts for Windows (WinRT Toast), macOS (osascript), and Linux (notify-send, with fallback).
- No third-party dependencies; uses native system APIs.
- Customizable notification title and content via script parameters.
- Provides one-click setup scripts to enable global automatic notifications after every task.
- All scripts secure, offline-ready, and do not modify user config without explicit setup.
